summary: Develop departmental plans, decision rights, scorecards, and change roadmaps in five days. Explore advanced strategic leadership training and enquire.
lede: Strategic leadership helps senior heads of department turn organizational priorities into executable plans and accountable decisions. Participants assess context with PESTLE and SWOT, set measurable outcomes with a Balanced Scorecard, and clarify decision rights and accountability through RAPID and RACI. They also draft change and adoption plans and practise reviewing progress and reporting priorities to executives.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior leaders who set departmental direction, allocate resources, deliver cross-functional priorities, and report results to executive teams. This course is designed for: Heads of Department setting annual priorities and aligning departmental plans. Operations Directors balancing service delivery, capacity, and strategic commitments. Finance Directors reviewing resource trade-offs across departmental initiatives. Human Resources Directors aligning workforce plans with organizational priorities. Strategy and Planning Heads translating corporate objectives into departmental scorecards. Transformation Directors coordinating change portfolios across business functions. Chief Information Officers prioritizing technology investments against departmental outcomes. Programme Directors resolving cross-functional dependencies and escalation decisions. Quality Directors linking improvement priorities to measurable service outcomes. Senior Policy and Governance Heads reporting strategic progress to executive committees.
prerequisites: Prior experience leading a department or functional team is expected, along with responsibility for planning, people, budgets, or performance reporting. Coding is not required. Bring a current or representative departmental priority to use in the planning exercises; no confidential organizational data is needed.
